en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an outdoor restaurant garden with many tables and benches under tall trees, bordered by a stone wall along a small river or canal with a railing in the foreground. In the background are wooded hills. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as the Schloss-Gasthof Weesenstein in the Müglitz valley, featuring a linden tree garden and dance hall.
